judgments.subject: shared workspace resource admission
judgments.conclusion: An App Server workspace-coordination service owns resource leases and fencing generations; neither a role, chatboard message, nor Git adapter owns that authority.

judgments.subject: canonical Git branch mutation
judgments.conclusion: Only the server-owned Git publisher may admit an authorized canonical branch mutation, atomically checking resource fencing and expected parent at the mutation boundary.

judgments.subject: isolated agent worktrees and namespaced resources
judgments.conclusion: Semantically disjoint agents can still corrupt one another through a shared index, branch ref, fixed directory, port, cache, database, or provider allocation; advisory intent cannot prevent that invalid state.
